summary: TEG Overseas filed an 8-K disclosing that its Uzbek subsidiary TEG SPV signed a non-binding preliminary agreement on November 3, 2026 to acquire the Alfraganus hotel complex—six hotels plus a shared conference hall under construction in Tashkent—from Dreams Island LLC, a Company affiliate. Consideration is UZS 12 billion (about US$1 million, VAT-inclusive) plus assumption of US$100 million of bank construction debt. A binding Main Agreement is targeted by June 30, 2027, subject to bank and third-party consents. Watch related-party terms and bank consent risk.
